title: Test a price function for an integer program
heading: A MILP's Dual Is a Function, Not a Number
cases: the value function is dual feasible, and a linear price below some column's value is not
superadditivity must hold for every pair d, e, not only for d = e
F(1) >= 0 is a rule of its own: leaving a unit unused is never worth less than nothing
a column whose value F meets exactly, F(a_j) = c_j, satisfies its rule
